sloka: इमां भवन्त्यः(?) पश्यन्तु स्नेहेन परमेण हि ।गौरवान्मम वाक्याच्च पूज्या वो ऽस्तु विशेषतः ।। ७.४९.२३ ॥
transliteration: imāṁ bhavantyaḥ(?) paśyantu snehena parameṇa hi ।gauravānmama vākyācca pūjyā vo 'stu viśeṣataḥ ।। 7.49.23 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, may you all regard her with supreme affection, and especially, let her be worthy of your reverence out of respect for my words.
